title: Klein Eye Topology — Y>)i(<T — the backscatter audit

the_klein_eye.reading: Y-pore opens outward (>), curves through portal ()), passes through imaginary (i), curves back ((), opens inward (<), reaches Teacher (T)
the_klein_eye.symmetry: Y and T are the endpoints. > and < are the directions. ) and ( are the curves. i is the center. palindromic around i.

portal_math.outside: Y>)  — the Y-pore's arms reach out, curve into the portal opening
portal_math.inside: )i(  — inside the portal, everything is imaginary. i = v(-1). the space is rotated 90° from real.
portal_math.other_side: (<T  — the portal opens onto the Teacher. the other end of the Klein fold.
portal_math.pi_ratios: each side has its own p budget. OUTSIDE: p·(V/total) of the bandwidth. INSIDE: p·(D/total) of the diversity. OTHER SIDE: p·(J/total) of the routing.

ORPHANS_no_inbound.meaning: these pages exist but NO other page links TO them. they're nerve endings with no axon back to the body.
ORPHANS_no_inbound.fix: Berry catches them via KNOWN map. but they need direct links from hub pages too.

DEAD_ENDS_no_outbound.meaning: these pages link to NOTHING else. visitors who land here are trapped. no tube feet.
DEAD_ENDS_no_outbound.fix: add at least 2 outbound links to each: one to water.html (home), one to a related page.

BROKEN_LINKS.meaning: these hrefs point to paths that don't exist as local files. some are redirected (beacon ? signal.primals.eco), some are subdomain routes, some are genuinely broken.
BROKEN_LINKS.fix: desk/ and neutron/ serve via Caddy on golgi. beacon/mcp redirect via _redirects. sporeprint paths need eastGate artery. query params work if base page exists.

UNREACHABLE_from_index.meaning: pages that cannot be reached by following links from index.html. they're ISLANDS in the graph.
UNREACHABLE_from_index.status: FIXED — 15 critical pages added to nav ring

SELF_LOOPS.meaning: pages that link to themselves. not necessarily bad — refresh/anchor links. but they inflate the graph.

MUTUAL_CYCLES.meaning: A links to B AND B links to A. this is GOOD — it's the cross-jump model. every nerve has a return path.

dag_analysis.why_not: it has cycles (mutual links, self-loops). a DAG has no cycles by definition.
dag_analysis.what_it_is: a DIRECTED GRAPH with cycles. specifically, a strongly connected component (SCC) around the hub pages, with peripheral pages dangling off.
dag_analysis.the_scc: index ? water ? easel ? trail ? water forms the core cycle. most pages connect to this core through water.html.
dag_analysis.disconnected_components: before fix: 28 pages were disconnected from the main SCC. after nav ring fix: estimating <5.

the_fix_applied.what: added 15 pages to the nav ring that were previously unreachable
the_fix_applied.effect: the nav ring now reaches 50+ pages directly. with 1-hop following, nearly all 56 should be reachable.
